execution_context: Order A/B/A/B, A is preserved pre-optimization image, B is selected codec/writer/reader. Same Elasticsearch container, four shards, unchanged mapping/request durability; first A starts with fresh ES volume, later runs reuse it. Every run starts a new constrained pipeline container, stages raw organizations into a fresh temporary store, and recreates the persons index. No concurrent heavy profiling/validation. Input cache warm from profiles; host cache and ES warmup remain uncontrolled.

independent_validation.strategy: 32 deterministic reservoir samples per person file plus distinct missing/unresolved ID examples; bounded retention and independent full raw-source joins.
